versions.changelog: Self-contained skill. Removed all external code and git clone references. Compression rules now documented directly in SKILL.md.

- Removed the file llmcom-cli.js from the project.
- CLI usage and documentation remain in SKILL.md, but actual CLI functionality has been deleted.
Simplified documentation to match CLI features

Initial release of LLMCOM Prompt Generator skill.

Features:
- Claude Code / Cursor CLI domain support with optimized compression
- 6 domains: Claude Code, Image Gen, Code Gen, LLM Dev, Research, Support
- 3-layer compression (Syntactic, Semantic, Abbreviation)
- 40-80% token reduction with 85%+ semantic preservation
- CLI wrapper for quick compression from command line

Claude Code Domain:
- Keywords: refactor, review, fix, test, audit, security
- Template: agent[task]|scope|focus|action|context|constraints
- Examples: agent[refac]|module|types|review|@src/auth|strict

Files: SKILL.md, llmcom-cli.js, llmcom.bat
